Name: Livestock Horns and Glue
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/KHP7bwY.png[/img]
[size=3]

[img]https://imgur.com/dbYjEBd.png[/img][/size]
[/center]


[left][size=3]Cows, Goats, and Sheep now drop horns every week after you gain 4 hearts (800 Friendship) with them! On top of being valuable by themselves, they can also be turned into glue in a Preserves Jar after gaining 3 hearts with Marnie and completing a new Special Order put up by her. A second Special Order from Robin may also appear afterward.[/size][/left]
[left]


[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/PxskLsr.png[/img][/size]



[left][size=3][b][color=#e69138]Exclude Items From Perfection (Default False):[/color][/b] Decides if all items count towards shipping collection completion.

[b][color=#e69138]Lock Gluemaking Behind Quest (Default True):[/color][/b] If disabled, Marnie's Special Order won't be added and glue processing will work immediately without having to unlock it.

[color=#e69138][b]Item Toggles (All Default True): [/b][/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Cow Horns: [/b][/color]Add or remove the ability for Cows to drop horns.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Goat Horns: [/b][/color]Add or remove the ability for Goats to drop horns.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Sheep Horns:[/b][/color] Add or remove the ability for Sheep to drop horns.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Glue:[/b][/color] Add or remove Glue as an item -- this also disables both Special Orders.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#e69138][b]Bone Glue:[/b][/color] Allows you to turn certain bone artifacts and/or 25 Bone Fragments into Glue.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[center][size=3][img]https://imgur.com/EBhe1ah.png[/img][/size][/center]

[size=3]Animals from these mods can also drop this mod's horns:[/size][/left]
[left][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24891?tab=files][size=3]Dairy Sheep [/size][/url][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][size=3]This mod's Glue can also be made with horns and antlers from these mods:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45939]Mizu's Deer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45763]Reindeer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45940]Buffalo[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46466]Yak[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7176]The Cowboy Life Expanded[/url] (It's reccomended to toggle off the Goat and Sheep horns from this mod if you want to prevent duplicate items!)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42997]Radical Reindeer[/url][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul [/url]is installed, the prices of horns and glue automatically change.[/size][/left]
[left][size=3]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44980]Pelican Town Wholesale[/url] is installed, Robin's Special Order will appear on its order board instead of the [/size]vanilla[size=3] board. (You'll have to see the vanilla Special Order board's cutscene first for it to appear!)[/size][/left]
[left]
